title: Make validateApp require a non-empty owner in libs/shared-contracts
Pass owner (team from package.json) in core-shell, sub-route-billing and sub-route-reports
Build all apps, open PR, merge when green, confirm CD deploy

summary: PLAT-103: validateApp in libs/shared-contracts now throws unless app.owner is a non-empty string. core-shell (platform), sub-route-billing (payments) and sub-route-reports (insights) pass owner matching their package.json team. Shipped in PR #1 (merged to main; CI and CD green). Assumptions: owner is the field name (ticket names only the team); the value is hard-coded per app because the build inlines modules by text replacement and cannot import package.json; whitespace-only owner is rejected as empty; platformkit was not touched.
